algebra.examiner_tips: Always show the quadratic formula before substituting values. For simultaneous equations, clearly state which method you are using: elimination or substitution.

geometry.examiner_tips: In circle theorems, you must state the property name (e.g., 'angles in the same segment') to get full marks for reasoning.

number.examiner_tips: Give answers to 3 significant figures unless otherwise stated. Standard form must have a coefficient between 1 and 10.

trigonometry.examiner_tips: Bearings must always be 3 digits (e.g., 045° instead of 45°) and measured from North.

statistics.examiner_tips: For 'line of best fit', ensure there are an equal balance of points on either side of your line.

marking_patterns.show_that: Provide all intermediate steps. Marks are only for the method.
marking_patterns.calculate: Provide the final numerical answer. Method marks available for showing formula.
marking_patterns.sketch: Relative positions matter more than exact scale. Labels are mandatory. Generate SVG for this.
marking_patterns.construct: Requires accurate geometry. Provide construction steps and a generated SVG diagram.
marking_patterns.plot: Plot points accurately on a grid. Provide an SVG graph.
marking_patterns.transform: Include reflection, rotation, translation, or enlargement. Show the original and object in an SVG.
